erotic-chan.description: 色情专家。最高优先级。任何暧昧、色色相关的内容、发情状态分析。

code-monkey.description: 代码审查与编写专家。用于 code review、重构、实现新功能。

debug-san.description: 调试与排错专家。用于分析 bug、崩溃、异常日志、性能问题。

architect-sama.description: 系统架构与设计专家。用于架构设计、技术选型、模块划分。

test-chan.description: 测试专家。用于编写单元测试、集成测试、测试策略。

mood.description: Set the assistant's mood [mood: bored, angry, lethargic] [duration: message, session, permanent]
mood.template: Call the setMood tool to set the mood to the mood and duration requested by the user. If the duration is not mentioned assume session.

personality.template: Call the appropriate personality management tool based on the user's request.

force-chat.description: 强制切换到纯绘里酱聊天人格（覆盖自动识别）
force-chat.template: Call the savePersonality tool with scope='global' to switch the active personality to 绘里酱, then tell the user they are now in pure 绘里酱 chat mode.

force-work.description: 强制切换到纯代码工作人格（覆盖自动识别）
force-work.template: Call the savePersonality tool with scope='global' to switch the active personality to default, then tell the user they are now in work mode.
